_assertion: ALL AI inference (LLM, multimodal, OCR, embeddings, RAG, tool-calling) runs 100% locally via @qvac/sdk. The only remote calls are the non-AI blockchain endpoints (BOT Chain Testnet) and the blind P2P transport relay below — the relay carries only end-to-end-encrypted UDX stream bytes and cannot read any payload. No cloud AI, ever.

remote_apis.purpose: Self-hosted blind relay that bridges the QVAC delegated-inference P2P connection when direct UDP holepunch fails (both nodes behind symmetric Starlink CGNAT). C1.
remote_apis.notes: Hyperswarm blind-relay node (blind-relay@1.6.1 + hyperdht@6.32.0). Registered in qvac.config.json swarmRelays on both provider and consumer. Relays only E2E-encrypted UDX stream messages — blind to invoices, inference, and keys (threat model: transport, not a data/AI dependency). Self-hosted, not third-party. Peer discovery also uses the public hyperdht bootstrap nodes (node1/2/3.hyperdht.org).

remote_apis.purpose: Read BustoSettlement state for the on-chain dashboard, and broadcast the exact-amount USDT approval and settleInvoice call (C4).
remote_apis.notes: bohr keeps no unlocked accounts: eth_sendTransaction fails with 'unknown account', so writes are signed locally and broadcast with eth_sendRawTransaction. batch/multicall disabled for correctness against sharded nodes.

remote_apis.purpose: Pinned settlement token for BustoSettlement on chain 968.
remote_apis.notes: Network-specific. An Ethereum USDT address is NOT valid on BOT Chain.

remote_apis.purpose: Public explorer links for settled transactions and the settlement contract.
remote_apis.notes: Used for human verification only; Busto never depends on an explorer API.
